literaryAssessment.charactersActionsSuspense: The failed purse theft, repeated real dangers, improvised exits, awkward barrel travel, jewel decision and home auction carry the prose. No competence/management lessons or reader exercises substitute for events.
literaryAssessment.relationships: Gandalf advocates for a doubtful Bilbo; Thorin’s attachment and anger are prepared by the jewel sequence; Bilbo returns despite warning; the reconciliation remains Thorin’s action. These are compressed but coherent.
literaryAssessment.causalityAndPerspective: All six routes read continuously. Deep retains the corrected attack-target cause and second-hand post-knockout account; no invented eyewitness ending.
literaryAssessment.translationParity: All current RU/EN titles/bodies compared, including the repaired agreement and narrowed knowledge claim. No consequential quantity, cause, relationship or ending mismatch found.
literaryAssessment.interpretationBoundary: The deathbed reflection is attributed to Thorin and the final reflection to Gandalf. Foster’s teaching theology is not silently made an author fact.
